versions.changelog:
Website Migration Orchestrator v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces an end-to-end enterprise website migration skill, designed to move existing sites (content + SEO) to a new SaaS platform.
- Orchestrates a 19-step pipeline: from old site analysis and content structuring to new site generation, URL/301 mapping, SEO & GEO checks, and go-live.
- Enforces dependency confirmation and installation of key partner skills (website builder, SEO check, GEO check) prior to any data migration.
- Requires all user inputs (source URL, migration mode, SEO preference, etc.) to be collected via structured forms—no sequential chat questions.
- Adds strict pre-checks: copyright compliance, source site ownership verification, and conditional access based on migration type.
- Guides usage for both 1:1 UI copy and redesign migrations, always aiming to preserve content completeness and SEO equity.
